entrypoints: --repo and --thread-id optionally narrow the exact targets
auto.py start --thread-id ID --repo PATH --scope SCOPE --sources FILE --mode native --wake-transport manual; then follow generated instructions.md
content.state: The OS-locked registry remains the sole grant owner. Every transaction derives recovery.run_finished, queue_finished, batch_finished, stopped, needs_input, active, work_reserved, next_check_at and dispatch; thread.json and progress.json expose the same data. An old completed batch is never a new grant.
content.selection: Only enabled native registered/waiting_turn_end/waiting_limit/executing grants below their batch limit, without blocking needs or unacknowledged delivery. Preserve own interrupted inflight reservation for reconciliation. Other project reservations block delivery. Native desktop idle/notLoaded may be woken; active/systemError/unknown, archived or incomplete coverage may not.
content.transport: Version-sensitive Python adapter to the bundled codex-app-tools local pipe (Windows) or explicitly supplied Unix socket. Discover actual tool schemas, call list_threads and get_usage_limits; fill a truncated list using read-only local IDs plus native read_thread status for every missing ID, then refresh recent list. read_thread works outside an active caller turn; native wait_threads is tied to the caller turn and is not used by this external runner. Never use private App Server or SQLite to infer activity. Call send_message_to_thread with the exact registered threadId and literal CONTINUE-AUTO, without model/effort overrides. Missing app/tools/protocol/limits/coverage blocks sending.
content.delivery: Commit a UUID wake_dispatch=prepared before transport. Pending prepared/sent/unknown blocks duplicate delivery and other AUTO reservations for the project. Record sent only for successful exact-recipient acknowledgement; any ambiguous response remains unknown. native-begin acknowledges receipt in its active desktop turn before normal project/limit checks; do not erase old work or count a second step. No timeout discards an uncertain delivery. The prepared outbox stores the exact normal or post-limit prompt.
content.reconcile: After manually checking history, operator may run resume_auto.py --thread-id ID --resolve-delivery DELIVERY_ID --confirmed-consumed-or-not-delivered. Exact current run/token required; command only resolves delivery and never sends or clears work. Do not use it merely because time elapsed.
content.manual_mode: New START defaults to wake_transport=manual. use-manual-transport --thread-id ID --run-id RUN detaches scheduler_id into retired_scheduler_id without resetting enabled/state/progress/inflight. Pause the exact existing automation through automation_update before migration. attach-scheduler is an explicit legacy heartbeat opt-in; do not use it in normal AUTO or rearm the retired timer.
content.configuration:
Standalone CMD requires no --configure and no CODEX_THREAD_ID. For each eligible grant, use its exact registered thread_id as desktop tool caller context; send destination remains the independently checked exact grant ID. Optional --caller-thread-id, CODEX_THREAD_ID or saved recovery-client.json override that context; no latest-chat guessing. --configure is an optional override setup only. Terminal/backoff/pending grants need no desktop connection. Windows discovers the unique live codex-app-tools pipe on every invocation; ambiguous instances require --endpoint. Linux needs a compatible explicit local Unix socket. last-recovery.json stores results without private thread messages.
Po bezpośredniej zgodzie właściciela na rozszerzenie aktywnej kolejki zapisz najpierw nowy uporządkowany zakres w kanonicznym planie. auto.py amend --thread-id ID --run-id RUN --scope TEKST --batch-size N --approval-note TEKST [--prompt-context TEKST] zmienia wyłącznie scope, limit i opcjonalny kontekst. Wymaga dokładnego aktywnego nieterminalnego runu bez inflight; limit wolno tylko zachować lub zwiększyć. Repo/źródła/tryb/transport są stałe. Zachowuje run_id, licznik, receipts, historię, checkpoint, potrzeby operatora i recovery. Zapisuje rewizję z uzasadnieniem zgody, unieważnia projekcję zadań; następna rezerwacja wymaga świeżych źródeł. Powtórzenie jest idempotentne. Nie wznawia STOP/terminal, nie wysyła prompta, nie tworzy schedulera ani nowego runu. Zmiana grantu nie jest ukończeniem jednostki AUTO.
content.verification: Tests cover immediate per-unit continuation, duplicate wake, STOP, batch, project busy and limits; quiet repeated status/errors/countdown; latest reset across exhausted windows; account-denial reset preservation; fresh denial after reset and one annotated send. Live production idle delivery and actual hard-limit recovery remain operator checks.
content.concurrency: Desktop observation and message enqueue are not one application transaction. If human input or another heartbeat starts in that interval, normal native-begin still blocks a second unit and STOP remains authoritative. The outbox prevents duplicate external sends; it does not claim exactly-once execution by a remote app. Do not override native project checks.
content.execution: START AUTO persists only the explicitly approved scope/source/batch in the shared registry. Agent CONTINUE-AUTO reads generated instructions, prepares a source-hashed task list and fresh native-snapshot, then native-begin before work. Finalize only after project checks/commit/push; auto.py finalize requires exact run/wake/receipt. Only todo/progress execute; needs_input/STOP/batch/queue completion remain terminal. Project-specific task-export adapters are optional and are not assumed by the portable toolkit. Manual AUTO self-continues immediately in the current chat/turn after a successful finalizer returns continuation.action=continue_current_turn. Refresh source task projection and authoritative native snapshot, then native-begin for each unit with current turn ID + :auto: + completed. Retry the same unit with the same wake ID. STOP, needs_input, batch/queue completion, account limits and project locks stop chaining. No messages to self and no native heartbeat in manual mode. START opens/reuses one visible CMD watchdog; closing CMD stops future recovery checks only. Ordinary recovery sends exactly CONTINUE-AUTO to the registered ID. After a previously observed limit and a fresh available account snapshot, send exactly CONTINUE-AUTO (limit reached previously, continue). Persist that prompt in the prepared outbox. The suffix is transport metadata, never prompt_context or a scope change, and does not bypass native-begin. Terminal/input-blocked tasks remain asleep.

console_scheduler.entrypoint: AUTO scheduler.bat -> console_scheduler.py (OS ownership lock) -> foreground CMD --loop -> one-shot resume_auto.py --watchdog. Foreground CMD checks every300s, or600s while the checker reports an account limit (exit10). Python always performs one sweep and exits. Limit data is queried again at most every600s, even when a later reset is known; the clock alone never authorizes sending. Preserve native project/limit checks and OS-locked outbox. Unknown delivery is never automatically retried.
console_scheduler.once: resume_auto.py always performs one sweep and exits. AUTO scheduler.bat --once performs one sweep and returns the checker exit code, without waiting. Scheduler wait failure exits instead of spinning.

console_scheduler.status_changes: Console prints only changed status/error/reset time or a new successful send. Identical checks, countdown-only changes and initially inactive historical grants stay quiet. watchdog-status.json stores fingerprints, last-recovery.json is an overwritten snapshot. On entering a limit show its known local reset date/time and remaining minutes; unknown reset stays explicit. SOCRATEX_AUTO_TIMEZONE defaults to Europe/Warsaw, with OS local fallback when zone data is unavailable.

unattended_shutdown.title: Nocne AUTO i wyłączenie komputera
unattended_shutdown.contract: Tryb nocny wyłącznie po jawnym poleceniu właściciela, np. CONTINUE AUTO + LIMIT SHUT DOWN. Dotyczy dokładnego thread_id/run_id aktywnego Native AUTO, bez poszerzania kolejki ani restartu terminalnego runa. Najpierw zapisz ustawienie przez auto.py shutdown-policy --thread-id ID --run-id RUN --enable --approval-note "jawne polecenie użytkownika", zapewnij działający CMD scheduler, potem wykonuj normalny zatwierdzony AUTO. Nie zadawaj pytań w tym trybie; obowiązkową decyzję lub błąd zapisz jako needs_input, a gdy poprawna finalizacja jest niemożliwa użyj shutdown-blocked --reason OPIS. Nie zgaduj decyzji, nie pomijaj testów, nie naliczaj ukończenia ani fikcyjnego commitu. Po świeżym natywnym potwierdzeniu limitu, końca partii/kolejki albo blokady watchdog zapisuje checkpoint, odczekuje własne30s i wyłącza Windows. Nie czeka na build. Bieżący czat/projekt i widoczne inne czaty muszą być bezczynne; prywatny App Server i stary snapshot nie są dowodem. STOP AUTO albo shutdown-policy --disable anuluje przed dispatch. CANCEL AUTO SHUTDOWN oznacza samo anulowanie opcji, bez zatrzymania kolejki. Domyślnie wyłączone; nie dziedziczy się na nowy run ani nowy start Windows. Status i dry-run nigdy nie wyłączają komputera. Po zleceniu/błędzie komendy nie ma automatycznej powtórki ani wznowienia w tej samej sesji bez anulowania; po restarcie zwykłe wznowienie może kontynuować zachowaną rezerwację. Monitor używa dotychczasowej kadencji, a podczas własnego odliczania sprawdza co5s; zmiany statusu pokazuje raz. Normalne zamknięcie Windows, bez wymuszenia utraty niezapisanych danych innych aplikacji; mogą one zatrzymać zamknięcie. Implementacja/test tej funkcji nie oznacza jej uzbrojenia.
